title: John Norseen's biofusion thought-controlled cockpit

tellings.quote: In 1999, Norseen published a report on biofusion, a system he later described involving brain-computer interfaces that convert thoughts into commands.

plain: In 1999 a researcher at the defense company Lockheed Martin named John Norseen wrote a report on "biofusion", a system he later described as linking brains to computers so a pilot's thoughts could become commands in the cockpit. The report was called Biofusion Reflexive Control and Neuro-ergonomic Integration in Adaptive Cockpits. Michels tells this himself in an episode about a UFO book the Pentagon tried to censor, as a sign that the military was working on mind-controlled machines.
